answer: Make cloning pay glacier rent. Each identity posts a bond that unlocks only as a glacier moves: one verified epoch frees one slice. Its stake rests in a karst chamber shared with strangers; a proven cheat drains the whole chamber, and the drain grows with chamber size. A sparrow gains standing only through attestations from peers outside its funding cluster, each endorsing a single identity. Fielding N copies needs N slow bonds, N chambers, and N endorsement sets. One exposed chamber costs a loss growing with the square of its size, while an honest participant hazards only one bond.
